verdict.rationale: Netlify documents that every pull request gets a preview URL through Deploy Previews, and a community user confirms the GitHub integration renders a preview build of each PR. No evidence shows that these previews are full-stack, meaning per-PR serverless functions or database or backing-data isolation, or that they are ephemeral and torn down after the PR closes. missing for 10: evidence that previews include functions and per-PR database or data environments, documented ephemeral lifecycle/cleanup on PR close.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Every PR gets a preview URL.
Review every change before it goes live with Deploy Previews
Share preview URLs of your in-progress content and code so you can review before launching changes to production.
The killer feature is the GitHub integration that renders a preview build of every PR.
